title: BPSC Exam Calendar 2025-26 Released; 71st CCE Mains, Interview In March/April | Education and Career News - News18
text: BPSC Exam Calendar 2025-26 Out: The Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released its exam calendar for 2025-26, outlining recruitment and exam schedules for various positions across the state. The commission posted the exam calendar on its official X handle. According to the BPSC exam calendar, several key exams and their results will be announced in 2026. These include the Integrated CCE 70th Main Exam and Interview, the District Statistical Officer/Assistant Director Exam, recruitment for secondary and higher secondary teachers, and positions of Principal and Vice Principal at Simultala Residential School. Results or interviews for all are expected to be announced in January 2026. Additionally, recruitment exams for several technical positions, including Special Educator, Assistant Education Development Officer, Assistant Town Planner, etc., will be held in January 2026. As per the calendar, the Integrated CCE 71st Main exam and interview phase will be held in March-April 2026. Results for other exams, including the Combined Assistant Engineer recruitment, will be announced later that year. According to the notice, the 70th CCE mains exam result will be released on December this year. The Secondary and Higher Secondary Teacher (Simultala Residential School, Jamui) mains exam will be held in January 2026, while the District Statistical Officer / Assistant Director prelims result will be released in November 2025 with mains exam slated to be conducted in December. Meanwhile, the Assistant Professor (Physics) final result will be declared in November, the Lecturer, Mining Engineering (Govt. Polytechnic/Women’s Polytechnic Institute) interview will be held in December, the Mineral Development Officer and the Vice Principal and equivalent (ITI, under Labour Resources Department) written exam results will be out in November this year. The written exam results of the Junior Laboratory Assistant, Assistant Environment Officer, Public Relations Office recruitment drive by the Bihar State Pollution Control Board will be released in November.
